description: Reminds Claude, at every session start, to write the closing message with the recap skill.

hooks.command: echo 'Before the closing message of any turn that did work (a finished task, a stop to ask the user for a decision or an action, a hand-over of unfinished work), load the recap skill (recap:recap) and follow it. After an analysis or an explanation that leaves something to decide, do or check, write the answer first and the recap sections after it. Write a prompt for a new session only when the user asks for one. Not for an answer that leaves nothing open.'
